data.name: Ever Vigilant
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you are protected by death ward, except the immunity to energy drain ends after it has prevented %1 negative levels; this resets when you next perform your obedience. You gain a +2 profane bonus on saving throws against effects that occur before your first turn in combat.|ExaltedBoonLVL
